senses.gloss: f. (a corruption of ἐνεχυρασία) taking property in pledge, writ of seizure = אַדְרַכְתָּא.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 1:7">Tosef. B. Mets. I, 7</cite> <he>אונקליטיא וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="A00767"><he>אונקילוסיא</he></cite>, corr. acc.) when a writ of seizure is found, if the debtor admits its correctness, it must be returned to the creditor; if not, it must be returned to neither.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 11a">B. Bath. XI, </cite>5 <he>אנקלסיא וכ׳</he> (<he>אינ׳</he>, <cite ref="A02300"><he>אונ׳</he></cite>) a writ of seizure may be written out without notifying the creditor, but not without notifying the debtor and giving him time to protest; v.
